notes: DEMO READINESS: unified assets/css/phf-checklist.css typography/control scale across all Checklist roles and screens ahead of the company-wide demo. Added typography custom properties (--phfck-font-family, --phfck-fs-*) to the existing :root token block. No layout, color, API, SQL, router, auth, or capability changes - CSS only.
